name: TPB
title: I Saw Santa #1
desc: When one troubled child receives a lump of coal from Santa, rather than the expected gift, it sets him on a bitter warpath to exact revenge upon Jolly Ol’ Saint Nick. The hopes and fears of all the years are met with Sam and Twitch as they unwrap a series of grim clues and Spawn is called upon to confront the relentless tormentor and restore peace to the holiday season. Collects I SAW SANTA #1-2
